name: save_enquiry
description: Save a caller's enquiry for the Mannoli team to call back. Use only after reading the details back and the caller has confirmed them.

name.description: Caller's name as they said it.

language.description: Language the caller spoke, so the team calls back in it.

products.description: Products or designs they asked about, like 'Ganesha wall plaque'.

quantity.description: Quantity in digits if given, like '25'. Empty if not known.

city_or_pincode.description: City, area or 6-digit pincode for delivery.

callback_time.description: When they want a callback, like 'tomorrow evening'.

whatsapp_consent.description: True only if the caller clearly agreed to WhatsApp messages.

notes.description: Anything else important, in one short English sentence.

name: transfer_call
description: Transfer the caller to a Mannoli team member. Usually a built-in tool on the platform; configure the owner's number there.

reason.description: Short reason, like 'asked for a person' or 'complaint'.

name: end_call
description: Hang up politely after the closing line. Usually built in on the platform.
